displayIdentity.body: Peter names Paul as a beloved brother whose letters are difficult. Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight. But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
